historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores full SDR capture and mapped sensor status evaluation.

original_test_intent: Verify the correct BMC exposes every expected H100/SXM GPU-board sensor and that each mapped sensor has a readable, fresh, unit-correct status/value satisfying the approved healthy-state map.
original_method: Bind BMC to SUT and expected H100 slot/module inventory; collect complete SDR and sensor metadata read-only through secure OOB; map sensor ID/entity/owner/slot/name to each GPU board; validate presence, availability, state, reading, units, thresholds and freshness; preserve missing/unknown explicitly; correlate SEL/log state and verify no management change.
manual_activity: Platform/BMC owner supplies the exact H100-to-sensor inventory and healthy-state/threshold semantics, verifies the endpoint and owns missing/abnormal sensor disposition.
required_inputs: Verified BMC identity/address and secure credentials
Protected/redacted evidence and SEL correlation policy
safety_requirements: Verify target BMC independently before query
Use complete read-only SDR capture without password/host-key bypass
Do not treat grep absence, disabled or unavailable as healthy
Validate units/freshness and bind sensor to physical module
Stop on endpoint/session anomaly; never reset, clear or write
agent_execution_scope: Collect full SDR then derive scoped mapped rows
Evaluate completeness and approved health semantics
Correlate SEL and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve missing, unavailable or abnormal readings

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broad filtered output can omit source SXM records and has unsafe transport; it cannot prove all expected modules.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete approved `ipmitool sdr elist` from the verified BMC, preserve raw output, then select sensors by the approved entity/ID map; `sxm` is a convenience filter only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source SDR command and five-minute timing remain while scope is strengthened to every expected H100 sensor.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce an expected-versus-observed table keyed by physical module/slot and sensor ID, retaining status, reading, units, threshold, freshness and absence reason from a hashed full SDR.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines displayed correctly as complete, attributable, fresh and within approved state rather than matching grep text.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A partial GPU/NVLink/module subset cannot substitute for every expected H100/SXM sensor.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sensor naming can vary across BMC firmware; stable entity/ID and platform map are more reliable than text alone.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner defines required versus optional sensors per H100 board revision and how discrete status and numeric thresholds combine.
expected_evidence: BMC platform/controller identity and secure-access audit
Expected H100 module/slot and sensor map revision
Full raw SDR/hash and exact argv/tool version/timestamps
SEL/BMC event correlation and no-write/reset audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requires H100/SXM BMC sensor status; generic wording is underdefined but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Endpoint, sensor map and status rules are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Replaces fragile grep-based visual confirmation with a complete physical-module sensor reconciliation and explicit missing/unavailable semantics.
independent_technical_reasoning: A grep can return healthy rows while omitting an entire missing module, so completeness must be established against expected count before evaluating state. Sensor values require units and freshness; a stale in-range value is not current health. BMC textual names may change, making entity/ID plus physical slot mapping essential. Missing, unavailable and disabled are distinct evidence states and cannot all be treated as healthy.
